def dp(p):

def finite_proof(arr, qq, hh):
    ss = [[[F(q), F(h)] for q, h in s] for s in arr]
    polys, der, joins, anchors = [], [], [], []
    for s in ss:
        qp, hp = coeff([p[0] for p in s]), coeff([p[1] for p in s])
        qd, hd = dp(qp), dp(hp)
        qt, qlo, qhi = extrema2(qd); ht, hlo, hhi = extrema2(hd)
        assert qlo > 0 and hhi < 0
        curvature_numerator = [hd[1]*qd[0]-hd[0]*qd[1],
            2*(hd[2]*qd[0]-hd[0]*qd[2]), hd[2]*qd[1]-hd[1]*qd[2]]
        nt, nlo, nhi = extrema2(curvature_numerator)
        positive_second_upper = max(F(0),nhi)/qlo**3
        # Diagnostic only: exact finite strict decrease remains asserted above.
        polys.append((qp, hp))
        second0 = (ev(dp(hd), F(0))*ev(qd, F(0))-ev(hd, F(0))*ev(dp(qd), F(0)))/ev(qd, F(0))**3
        second1 = (ev(dp(hd), F(1))*ev(qd, F(1))-ev(hd, F(1))*ev(dp(qd), F(1)))/ev(qd, F(1))**3
        der.append({'Q_power_exact': list(map(str, qp)), 'H_power_exact': list(map(str, hp)),
                    'Q_dt_power_exact': list(map(str, qd)), 'H_dt_power_exact': list(map(str, hd)),
                    'Q_extrema_t_exact': list(map(str, qt)), 'H_extrema_t_exact': list(map(str, ht)),
                    'Q_dt_min_exact': str(qlo), 'H_dt_max_exact': str(hhi),
                    'dH_dQ_strict_negative_all_t': True,
                    'd2H_dQ2_numerator_power_exact':list(map(str,curvature_numerator)),
                    'd2H_dQ2_numerator_extrema_t_exact':list(map(str,nt)),
                    'd2H_dQ2_numerator_minmax_exact':[str(nlo),str(nhi)],
                    'positive_d2H_dQ2_upperbound_exact':str(positive_second_upper),
                    'concave_to_ordinary_1e8_bound':positive_second_upper <= F(1,10**8),
                    'd2H_dQ2_endpoint_exact': [str(second0), str(second1)],
                    'open_inflection_endpoint_sign_diagnostic': second0*second1 < 0})
    for (qa, ha), (qb, hb) in zip(polys, polys[1:]):
        delta0 = [ev(qa, F(1))-qb[0], ev(ha, F(1))-hb[0]]
        da, db = dp(qa), dp(qb); ea, eb = dp(ha), dp(hb)
        delta1 = ev(ea, F(1))/ev(da, F(1))-eb[0]/db[0]
        delta2 = ((ev(dp(ea), F(1))*ev(da, F(1))-ev(ea, F(1))*ev(dp(da), F(1)))/ev(da, F(1))**3
                  -(dp(eb)[0]*db[0]-eb[0]*dp(db)[0])/db[0]**3)
        assert max(map(abs, delta0)) <= F(1, 10**8) and abs(delta1) <= F(1, 10**8) and abs(delta2) <= F(1, 10**8)
        joins.append({'Q_exact': str(ev(qa, F(1))), 'C0_delta_exact': list(map(str, delta0)),
                      'C1_delta_exact': str(delta1), 'C2_delta_exact': str(delta2),
                      'ordinary_1e8_bound_PASS': True})
    assert ss[0][0] == [qq[0], F(hh[0])] and ss[-1][-1] == [qq[-1], F(hh[-1])]
    for i, (Q, H) in enumerate(zip(qq, hh)):
        qp, hp = next((q, h) for q, h in polys if q[0] <= Q <= ev(q, F(1)))
        if Q == qp[0]:
            lo = hi = F(0); role = 'DECLARED_PIECE_ENDPOINT'
        elif Q == ev(qp, F(1)):
            lo = hi = F(1); role = 'DECLARED_PIECE_ENDPOINT'
        else:
            lo, hi = F(0), F(1)
            for _ in range(80):
                mid = (lo+hi)/2
                if ev(qp, mid) <= Q:
                    lo = mid
                else:
                    hi = mid
            role = 'TRUE_Q_CROSSING_BISECTION80'
        hlow, hhigh = ev(hp, hi), ev(hp, lo)
        assert hlow <= hhigh
        err = max(abs(hlow-H), abs(hhigh-H))
        tol = max(F(1), F(H, 50)); assert err <= tol
        anchors.append({'i': i, 'Q_exact': str(Q), 'H_selected_integer': H,
                        'evaluation': role, 't_interval_exact': [str(lo), str(hi)],
                        'H_curve_interval_exact': [str(hlow), str(hhigh)],
                        'error_bound_m_exact': str(err), 'tolerance_m_exact': str(tol),
                        'ratio_upper_bound': float(err/tol), 'physical_6b_PASS': True})
    return {'segments': len(ss), 'derivative_segments': der, 'joins': joins,
            'table_points110_subset': anchors, 'endpoints_exact_finite20': True,
            'max_ratio': max(v['ratio_upper_bound'] for v in anchors),
            'max_error_m': max(float(F(v['error_bound_m_exact'])) for v in anchors),
            'true_Q_crossings': sum(v['evaluation'].startswith('TRUE') for v in anchors),
            'declared_piece_endpoints': sum(v['evaluation'].startswith('DECLARED') for v in anchors),
            'joins_max_abs_residual': max((float(abs(F(v[k]))) for v in joins for k in ('C1_delta_exact','C2_delta_exact')), default=0.),
            'open_inflection_segments_diagnostic': [i for i,v in enumerate(der) if v['open_inflection_endpoint_sign_diagnostic']]}
